essence: Akṣaranyāsa consists of placing designated syllables on designated body parts in sequence.
The deity should be meditated upon as seated on a lotus, holding a vīṇā, nectar-pot, rosary, and garland in shining hands.
The two speech goddesses named Saṃskṛta and Prākṛta should be worshipped on the sides.
Afterward, one should worship Prajñā, Medhā, Śruti, Smṛti, and Śakti.
The fourth enclosure includes the direction guardians, and one should recite the mantra twelve hundred thousand times.
